attacks.name: Nano Bio-Weapons
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!critical| |*Nanotech|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

attacks.name: Nano Power Suppression Systems
steps: After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt, the defender gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

superPowers.name: Guided Infection
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking, during the |*Modify Dice| step, if the defender has the Root special condition, this character may use this superpower. Remove the Root special condition from the defender. This character may reroll up to 2 of its dice.

superPowers.name: Sentinel Nanotech Corruption
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character is defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, if the attacker is within |!range| 3 and has the Root special condition, this character may use this superpower. Remove the Root special condition from the attacker. This character may reroll up to 2 of the attacker's dice.

superPowers.name: Sentinel Nanotech Infection
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends its Activation, if it is within |!range| 2 of this character, it gains the Root special condition.

superPowers.name: Bastion's Legion
superPowers.body: When building a Roster or a Squad, a player may include 2 of this character instead of the normal 1.
